( #{fault.faultNo}, #{fault.equipmentId}, #{fault.faultType}, #{fault.faultLevel}, #{fault.faultStatus}, #{fault.occurTime}, #{fault.discoverer}, #{fault.discovererId}, #{fault.phenomenon}, #{fault.causeAnalysis}, #{fault.temporaryMeasures}, #{fault.treatmentMeasures}, #{fault.treatmentStartTime}, #{fault.treatmentEndTime}, #{fault.handler}, #{fault.handlerId}, #{fault.actualDowntimeHours}, #{fault.impactScope}, #{fault.impactOutput}, #{fault.estimatedLoss}, #{fault.rootCause}, #{fault.preventiveMeasures}, #{fault.isRecurring}, #{fault.relatedMaintenanceId}, #{fault.faultImages}, #{fault.closer}, #{fault.closeTime}, #{fault.createTime}, #{fault.createBy}, #{fault.updateTime}, #{fault.updateBy} )

mapper.select: WITH fault_sequence AS ( SELECT equipment_id, occur_time, treatment_start_time, treatment_end_time, actual_downtime_hours, LAG(occur_time) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY occur_time) as prev_occur_time FROM mes_fault_record WHERE fault_status = 3 AND occur_time IS NOT NULL AND treatment_end_time IS NOT NULL ) SELECT equipment_id, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, prev_occur_time, occur_time)) as mtbf_hours, AVG(actual_downtime_hours) as mttr_hours, COUNT(*) as sample_count FROM fault_sequence WHERE prev_occur_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipment_id HAVING sample_count >= 3
